content.text:
The test now passes.

The bug was in `app/calc.py`: `mean` divided by `len(values) - 1` instead of `len(values)`, so `mean([2, 4, 6])` returned 6.0 instead of 4. I changed the divisor to `len(values)`. The fix is a one-line change, and `tests/test_calc.py` passes.

I didn't commit anything, since this directory isn't a git repository.
